text:
Sam: Hey team — working from the camper this week for a bit of R&R + meetings. quick rundown of my setup in case anyone wants a mobile office idea. photo: camper-desk.jpg
Sam: Router: small travel router with a USB port + phone tether as failover. Running a cheap 12V->USB power splitter so I can keep the router and a fan on overnight.
Sam: Hot tip: put the phone hotspot on 5GHz only. less noisy at campgrounds. turned off cellular data for updates to avoid surprise downloads.
Priya: love this. is the wifi good enough for video calls?
Sam: Mostly. morning zooms are fine. afternoons when the campground fills up it gets flaky. I run a tiny local nginx reverse proxy so my meeting client reconnects faster if the link drops (lol).
Jordan: Photo is adorable. how do you power everything? inverter?
Sam: I have a 300W inverter wired to the leisure battery. one caveat: the fridge spikes when compressor kicks and the router blips. added a cheap UPS for the router.
Marta: Did you try Starlink RV? Curious if you think it's worth the upgrade vs phone tether.
Sam: Not this trip. expensive for short stays. Starlink probably wins for stability but tether + small router + UPS is way cheaper for a week.
Priya: Can you share model of the travel router?
Sam: It’s a tiny GL-iNet-ish travel router — runs OpenWrt. config snippets below: 
Sam: ```
# hotspot as wan
uci set network.wan.proto=dhcp
uci set network.wan.ifname=wwan0
uci commit
```
Sam: (super trimmed, ping me if you want the full conf)
Jordan: LOL @ the nginx reconnect hack. only redwood engineers would. :laughing:
dev-net-bot: Reminder: please don't expose internal dashboards on public networks. Use VPN + 2FA.
Sam: Absolutely — VPN on at all times. I route all work traffic through our corp VPN.
Marta: Poll — best camper desk solution?
Marta: 1) Fold-down table 2) Swivel captain's chair + tray 3) Pop-up picnic table outside
Priya: 2 for ergonomics.
Jordan: 3 for sunshine and background b-roll.
Sam: 1 when you need to eat at the same spot.
Marta: Great tips. If anyone wants a checklist I can post my packing list (power, small router, UPS, ethernet dongle, surge strip, cable clips).
Sam: Please do. helped me avoid a panic Saturday when the router fell behind the fridge.
Priya: Camper office show-and-tell Friday? :camera_with_flash: :tent:
Jordan: I’m in. maybe I’ll bring my suitcase-desk prototype.
Marta: Count me in.
Sam: Thanks all — happy to share configs and a short diagram later this afternoon.
